provenance.text: AI-assisted original classroom writing, reviewed for child-friendly A2/B1 readability; dictionary sources are recorded in word_study.
provenance.images: No image asset in v1; the teaching page intentionally leaves the image area empty.

teaching.example: Mia smiles because the soup is delicious.
teaching.example_zh: 米娅笑了，因为汤很美味。

extra_examples.en: We stay inside because it is raining.
extra_examples.zh: 因为正在下雨，我们待在室内。

teaching.student_prompt: 先说一件事，再用 because 补充原因。
teaching.cloze: Mia smiles __________ the soup is delicious.
teaching.cloze_zh: 米娅笑了，因为汤很美味。
teaching.note: because 连接结果和原因；把它作为完整连接词记住。

word_study.explanation_zh: 把 because 作为完整连接词记住：前面说结果，后面接原因。

family.connection_zh: because of 后面通常接名词或名词短语。

example.en: The game stops because of the rain.

challenge.prompt_zh: because 后面接的是原因还是结果？
